title: PaleBlueDot AI Secures $200M Series C at $3.2B Valuation to Scale Enterprise AI Compute
key_facts: Palo Alto-based PaleBlueDot AI secured $200 million in Series C financing at a $3.2 billion valuation.
Round led by ComputeCore with participation from B Capital and other investors.
Capital to expand operations and accelerate development as demand for AI compute grows.
CEO Stephen Watts; offering combines self-owned GPU clusters, a GPU marketplace and serverless inference.
Clients in the United States and Japan together account for more than half of monthly revenue.
quote_evidence: Palo Alto-based PaleBlueDot AI, an intelligence infrastructure platform provider, has secured $200 million in Series C financing at a $3.2 billion valuation.
PaleBlueDot AI serves enterprise-scale customers worldwide, with clients in the United States and Japan together accounting for more than half of its monthly revenue.
why_it_matters_hint: $200M round for an AI-computing provider at a $3.2bn valuation.
notes: Full article read; one outlet only. The revenue claim is the company's own.
